entities.name: AS Security key update
entities.description: Procedure for updating AS security keys in the UE based on different triggers and network configurations.

entities.name: masterKeyUpdate
entities.description: Message that triggers AS security key update procedure when received by the UE.

entities.name: sk-Counter
entities.description: Counter value used for updating security keys in E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC connections.

entities.name: nas-Container
entities.description: Container that may be included in masterKeyUpdate message and forwarded to upper layers.

entities.name: keySetChangeIndicator
entities.description: Indicator that when set to true triggers derivation or update of KgNB key.

entities.name: nextHopChainingCount
entities.description: Value used for deriving or updating KgNB key and stored by the UE.

entities.name: securityAlgorithmConfig
entities.description: Configuration that includes ciphering and integrity protection algorithms for key derivation.

entities.name: KgNB key
entities.description: Base security key used for deriving other AS security keys.

entities.name: S-K key
entities.description: Secondary security key updated based on KgNB key and sk-Counter.

entities.name: KRRCenc key
entities.description: RRC ciphering key derived from base security keys.

entities.name: KUPenc key
entities.description: User plane ciphering key derived from base security keys.

entities.name: KRRCint key
entities.description: RRC integrity protection key derived from base security keys.

entities.name: KUPint key
entities.description: User plane integrity protection key derived from base security keys.

entities.name: UE connected to E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC
entities.description: Condition where UE is connected to E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC networks.

entities.name: masterKeyUpdate received
entities.description: Condition where the procedure was initiated due to reception of masterKeyUpdate message.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to be connected to E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC for certain key updates.
Procedure can be triggered by reception of masterKeyUpdate message.
masterKeyUpdate message may contain nas-Container IE.
When keySetChangeIndicator is set to true, KgNB key is derived or updated.
KgNB key is used to derive KRRCenc key for ciphering protection.
KgNB key is used to derive KUPenc key for ciphering protection.
KgNB key is used to derive KRRCint key for integrity protection.
KgNB key is used to derive KUPint key for integrity protection.
sk-Counter value is used to update the S-K key.
securityAlgorithmConfig indicates ciphering algorithm for KRRCenc key derivation.
securityAlgorithmConfig indicates integrity protection algorithm for KRRCint key derivation.
